summary: Alleged dispute over unpaid construction contract and construction materials; delay in filing FIR (2021 incident, 2023 registration); high court declined to quash FIR citing Bhajan Lal guidelines; challenge to quashing of criminal proceedings based on civil dispute
legal_provisions_cited: State of Haryana vs Bhajan Lal
M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs State of Maharashtra
Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati vs State of Uttar Pradesh
final_judgment: Appeal decided; quashing of FIR refused; matter remanded
